articles.title: Man, 57, dies following water rescue at Rochor Canal
articles.content: A 57-year-old man died after he was retrieved unconscious from Rochor Canal on Sunday evening (Aug 23). The Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) was also alerted to a water rescue incident near Wayang Satu Flyover at about 7.45pm, an SCDF spokesperson said. Upon SCDF's arrival, rescuers found an unconscious person floating in the canal. The 57-year-old subsequently died at the hospital. Based on preliminary investigations, the police do not suspect foul play. Investigations are ongoing.
